title: The Unquiet Will
author: Ansel Reyes
blurb: Wendell Villalobos, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
